title: Voxyris
description: Seamless combination of Voxy and Iris shaders. Enjoy massive render distance with shaders and great performance!
body:
### About **Voxyris** is a seamless combination of [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) and [Iris shaders](https://modrinth.com/project/YL57xq9U). Enjoy massive render distance with shaders and great performance! - 🎮 Controller Support. - 📷 In-game screenshot manager. - 🌍 Up to 2048 render distance. - 💡 Pre-installed Shaders. - ⚡ Lightweight, Optimized & Low memory usage. - 🔍 Zooming retains chunk quality. --- ### Shaders [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) only works with shader packs that explicitly add support for it. 21 compatible shader packs come preinstalled. You can find more here: https://samalando.com/voxy/shaders - Complementary(+ Euphoria patches), Photon, BSL, I Like Vanilla Shaders and more... ![Screenshot of landscape](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e200dea54bd2d3ac9eca384f599ee9372851a8e.webp) --- ### Performance Comparison ⚠️ Performance will vary depending on your hardware. Performance tested on Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz; 16GB 2933MT/s DDR4 RAM (4GB Allocated); NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 Ti 4GB (laptop edition) using lower lowest quality of chunks. ![Performance Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1794c9606992b5f5544ab0c732bbd5a542af332.webp) --- ### Zoom [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) adjusts the [level of detail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level_of_detail_(computer_graphics)) of chunks depending on how much screen space they actually take up. This means that even if you zoom in from far away, you won't end up looking at massive, single-colored blocks. ![Gif - zoom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/zwghPdKt/images/c5b30b8acc59fe2260b47216e38281b0b641c1aa.gif) ---
💡 FAQ **Why 2 versions of Voxyris?** > For server support to work you need [Voxy Server](https://modrinth.com/project/fNtGd1cx) mod, But it's incompatible with [Voxy WorldGen](https://modrinth.com/project/xT0lnNE9) (Mod that automaticly generates Voxy's chunks past your vanilla render distance). Pregenarate your world with chunky! Command: /chunky > If you want to play on servers, use [Voxyris: Server](https://modrinth.com/project/Gxjvky9m) > If you want to play singleplayer, use [Voxyris](https://modrinth.com/project/zwghPdKt) **What is Voxy?** > [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK) is a mod made by [Cortex](https://modrinth.com/user/f45kBWbv) that uses [Level of Detail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Level_of_detail_(computer_graphics)) to let you see beyond your normal render distance. **How to toggle shaders?** > Press "K" to toggle shaders, Press "O" to open shader pack menu or go to Options -> Video Setting -> Shader Packs **How to change Voxy's render distance?** > Go to options -> video settings -> Voxy -> Rendering **How to change quality of voxy's chunks?** > Go to options -> video settings -> Voxy -> Rendering -> "Pixels^2 of subdivison size" The higher the setting lower the quality. **Will you release for x.x.x Minecraft version?** > Only the newest version of Voxy will be supported. **List of things that are **not possible** or I don't what to do:** - Bedrock support. - Vulkan support. - Backport to older version. - Public Server
📌 Requirements A GPU/IGPU with [OpenGl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenGL) 4.6 support (this means very old GPUs like 10+ years old or Macs don’t work but to make sure your GPU has Opengl 4.6 support you can always check online) [Optional] For GPU accelerated chunk generation look at requirements here: [C2ME OpenCL Acceleration Module](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-ocl)
🔍 Credits Voxyris's logo is combination of [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/project/fxxUqruK)'s and [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/project/YL57xq9U)' Logo.
